source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary:
Before the event, each team sets up as follows:

- Pick 1 captain, who makes sure lists go in on time and scores are reported after each round.
- Each faction keyword may be used by just 1 player per team, so normally only 1 player uses each Codex, allies included. Exceptions: ally rules that alter faction keywords, and datasheets printed in several Codexes with differing faction keywords, such as Chaos Daemons, also printed as Khorne Daemons (Codex: World Eaters).
- Every player musters an army by following their Warhammer 40,000 app, then picks 1 Force Disposition card open to them and notes it on their roster.
- Each Force Disposition can be picked by at most 1 player per 5 team members, rounding up.

Examples:

- 5-player team: every player has a different Force Disposition.
- 8-player team: different players pick each Force Disposition once, then the other 3 players may each pick a 2nd copy of one.

The rest of the sequence is then played as a Warhammer Event battle.

duties: ensure scores are submitted at each round end

exceptions: same datasheet occurs in multiple Codexes under different faction keywords
